title: Data Engineer
description:
job title: data engineer


flsa status: exempt


hours: full\-time


salary range: $80,000\.00\-$90,000\.00 per year


this position is required to be in office based in omaha, nebraska.


about hurrdat:


hurrdat is one of a kind. a media, marketing, and entertainment agency.


we were founded in lincoln, nebraska as a small team of two in 2010, offering social media services to brands and athletes. after a decade of growth later we have grown to be a uniquely well\-rounded marketing and advertising agency with in\-house media, sports, entertainment, and film divisions.


mergers and acquisitions over the years (with b2 interactive, disconnected media, digital hero films, victory fighting championship, hail varsity, and parkville media) have grown our team to over 150 people.


we serve over 200 clients who collectively operate in 8 countries, including 43 states in the united states. our clients range from local businesses just starting to build their brand and online presence to enterprise organizations.


about the role:


we are seeking a data engineer to build and maintain the data models and pipelines behind hurrdat's analytics and reporting. you will work primarily in google bigquery and dbt, designing the warehouse models that turn advertising, content, web, and search data into governed, well\-documented tables that our reporting and client teams rely on every day. the role spans both paid media performance and content analytics, supporting how our teams measure organic content, seo, and editorial work alongside advertising campaigns. this is a hands\-on role with real ownership: you will design the models, write the transformations, build the pipelines that feed them, and own the datasets that reach our clients. it is well suited to someone with a strong sql and data modeling foundation who wants to deepen their work in a modern data stack. this position reports directly to the sr. ai/ml engineer.


duties and responsibilities (include but not limited to):


* design, build, and maintain data models that turn raw source data into clean, well\-structured tables for reporting and analysis.
* develop, test, and document transformations in dbt, including model logic, data tests, and version\-controlled code.
* build and maintain elt pipelines that bring advertising, content, web, and search data from third\-party platforms and apis into the warehouse.
* write python scripts to automate recurring data tasks and integrate with external apis.
* monitor scheduled pipeline runs, investigate failures, and resolve data quality issues such as schema changes, missing data, and duplicate records.
* apply version control and code review practices, including branching, pull requests, and peer review, to all data code.
* support warehouse performance and cost management through partitioning, clustering, and query optimization.
* partner with reporting, analytics, content, and account teams to translate business questions into reliable datasets and clear documentation.
* maintain documentation of data sources, table definitions, and model logic so that others can understand and use the data independently.
* assist with data preparation and infrastructure supporting the organization's ai and machine learning initiatives.

qualifications, knowledge, skills, and abilities:


* bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, information systems, statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* demonstrated experience with data modeling, including dimensional modeling, normalization and denormalization tradeoffs, and layered warehouse design such as a medallion (bronze, silver, gold) architecture.
* proficiency in sql, including joins, aggregations, window functions, common table expressions, and query troubleshooting.
* hands\-on experience building transformations in dbt, including models, tests, and documentation.
* working knowledge of python for scripting, data manipulation, and api integration.
* two to four years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or business intelligence development.
* experience with a cloud data warehouse such as bigquery, snowflake, or redshift. bigquery experience is preferred.
* familiarity with git\-based version control and code review workflows.
* exposure to marketing, advertising, or content performance data sources is a plus.
* clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical issues to non\-technical audiences.
* ability to work independently on well\-scoped tasks, ask questions early, and manage competing priorities.

candidates will be required to pass a pre\-employment background check.


working conditions and physical effort:


* work is normally performed in a typical office environment.
* will lift, push, pull, and/or move up to 15 pounds and occasionally up to 25 pounds using safe and proper lifting methods.
* prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* this position is based in the omaha, nebraska office.

benefits:


* health insurance
* dental insurance
* vision insurance
* life insurance
* parental leave
* employee discount’s
* 401(k) retirement plan
* responsible time off policy

disclaimer:


the information presented indicates the general nature and level of work expected of employees. it is not designed to contain, nor is it to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, qualifications, and objectives required of employees assigned to this position.

description:
axos bank**target range:**


$130,000\.00 /yr. \- $150,000\.00 /yr
actual starting pay will vary based on factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, experience, skills, specialty, and education.


eligible for an annual discretionary cash bonus target: 10%
eligible for an annual discretionary restricted stock units bonus target: 10%*these discretionary target bonuses may be awarded semi\-annually based upon your achievement of performance goals and targets.*

**about this job**


axos bank is hiring an ai platform engineer to engineer, operate, and help govern the platforms and infrastructure that power the bank’s ai and automation capabilities. this is a hands\-on, senior individual\-contributor role spanning platform engineering, the supporting data and compute tier, reliability, and platform governance — applied across a growing portfolio of enterprise ai and automation platforms rather than any single product.  

  

the successful candidate is platform\- and infrastructure\-focused: equally comfortable deploying and hardening an enterprise platform, tuning a postgresql cluster or redis tier, and establishing the engineering standards and controls the platform estate runs under. the role ensures that the bank’s ai and automation platforms are reliable, performant, secure, and well\-governed as adoption scales across lines of business.  

  

this is the hands\-on engineering seat behind our ai and automation platforms, the person who deploys, hardens, scales, and governs the platforms and the infrastructure they run on. the role offers deep technical ownership of a fast\-growing platform footprint, close partnership with senior architects in infrastructure, security, and identity, and a central part in scaling the bank’s automation center of excellence.**responsibilities:**
---------------------

**ai \& automation platform engineering**
-----------------------------------------

* **deploy, configure, upgrade, and operate the bank’s portfolio of enterprise ai and automation platforms across dev/qa/uat/prod — including high\-availability topology, scaling, version and patch management, and full platform lifecycle**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **tune platforms for performance, capacity, and cost as adoption grows; plan and execute upgrades and migrations with minimal service impact**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **integrate platforms with enterprise identity (entra id/oidc), secrets management, and source control; manage platform\-level rbac and credential lifecycle**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **evaluate and onboard new ai and automation platform capabilities into the supported estate**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**infrastructure \& data tier**
-------------------------------

* **engineer and operate the postgresql tier supporting the platform estate — replication, high availability and automated failover, point\-in\-time recovery, connection pooling, and performance/query tuning**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **engineer and operate the redis tier — persistence configuration, memory and eviction policy, queue durability, and high availability (sentinel or cluster)**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **engineer the linux hosts and docker/kubernetes containers running the platforms — hardening, patching, capacity, and performance tuning, in partnership with infrastructure**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **design, implement, and validate ha/dr for the platform data tier against defined rto/rpo — failover behavior, backup validation, and recurring recovery exercises**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**reliability \& observability engineering**
--------------------------------------------

* **instrument the platforms and their infrastructure for service health, replication/failover events, performance, and capacity using the enterprise observability stack**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **build and maintain dashboards, alerts, and runbooks; lead incident response and root\-cause analysis for platform and data\-tier events**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**automation, ci/cd \&** **infrastructure\-as\-code**
-----------------------------------------------------

* **build and maintain ci/cd pipelines and promotion workflows for platform artifacts and configuration across environments**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **manage** **infrastructure\-as\-code** **(terraform or equivalent) for the platform data and compute tier, and automate routine platform operations**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**platform governance, security \& compliance**
-----------------------------------------------

* **define, document, and enforce platform engineering standards, hardening baselines, rbac models, and configuration governance across the platform estate**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **partner with infosec, infrastructure, network, and identity on platform security operations — access reviews, key/secret rotation via pam, and control attestation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **operate within and contribute to the automation coe governance framework; support internal audit, vendor risk, and regulatory examination for the platforms in scope**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **document designs, runbooks, and standard operating procedures, and mentor junior engineers**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**requirements:**
-----------------

* **5\+ years of platform or infrastructure engineering experience in an enterprise environment, with a strong hands\-on (not primarily managerial) track record**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **hands\-on postgresql administration — replication, high availability, backup/restore, point\-in\-time recovery, connection pooling, and performance/query tuning**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **hands\-on redis operational experience — sentinel or cluster, persistence configuration, eviction policy, and queue/pub\-sub workloads**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **strong linux administration plus docker and containerized application operations (kubernetes a plus)**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **experience deploying, operating, and hardening enterprise platforms — such as workflow automation, integration/ipaas, data, or other application platforms — across multiple environments**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **strong scripting/coding proficiency in python or** **javascript/typescript**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **experience integrating platforms with entra id (or azure ad) for sso/oidc, rbac, and group\-based access**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **experience with ci/cd and** **infrastructure\-as\-code** **(terraform or equivalent)**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **experience with platform governance, security operations, and change management in a regulated environment (financial services, healthcare, or similar), including audit support**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **strong written communication for runbooks, design documents, and standard operating procedures**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**axos employee benefits may include:**

* medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
* paid sick leave, 3 weeks’ vacation, and holidays (about 11 a year)
* hsa or fsa account and other voluntary benefits
* 401(k) retirement saving plan with employer match program and 529 savings plan
* employee mortgage loan program and free access to an axos bank account with self\-directed trading

title: Senior GIS Engineer
description:
**jll empowers you to shape a brighter way**.


our people at jll are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. we are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.


**role overview**


the senior software engineer develops, tests, documents, and maintains robust, scalable full stack applications using modern technologies including ai, cloud platforms, gis, and devsecops practices. this role works across jll’s geospatial and enterprise data platforms on problems such as geocoding, data matching, and cross\-platform data alignment.

 **key responsibilities**

***design \& delivery***

* independently design and implement complex solutions — geospatial data pipelines, geocoding and matching services, and the interfaces between them — with testing, monitoring, and data\-quality validation built in
* solve medium to high complexity problems, including reconciling records across systems with differing identifiers and data models
* bring new perspectives to existing solutions, applying ai and automation to improve both products and development practices

***business partnership***

* work with product and business teams to influence solution decisions, translating business needs into technical requirements
* apply enterprise\-first thinking: contribute \& build shared capabilities and data contracts that serve multiple platforms and teams

***leadership \& communication***

* lead medium projects with manageable risks and serve as a trusted opinion in your product area
* coach less experienced engineers and deliver knowledge\-sharing sessions
* use storytelling to explain difficult concepts and build consensus across platform teams and business stakeholders

 **required qualifications**

*we don’t expect any single candidate to arrive with every skill listed below. if you’re strong on full stack development and have depth in either gis or applied ai, we want to hear from you — the rest is learnable on the job.*

 ***education***

* bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, geography/gis, or related field; equivalent practical experience considered

 ***experience \& skills***

* 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience with full stack expertise — frontend (react, modern javascript) and backend (c\#, .net)
* **geospatial:** gis data processing, mapping libraries and platforms, spatial databases, and location\-based services
* **geocoding \& matching:** hands\-on experience with geocoding frameworks (address standardization, composite geocoding, coordinate\-based matching) or with record matching and deduplication at scale
* **data integration:** defining data contracts, identifier mappings, and integration patterns across platforms; relational and nosql databases
* **ai/ml:** integrating ai capabilities into solutions; familiarity with llms (prompt engineering, api integration); proficiency with ai coding assistants to accelerate development
* **cloud \& devsecops:** a major cloud platform (aws, azure, or gcp), e2e ci/cd setup, and automated testing practices
* works independently on complex problems and builds alignment across teams without formal authority

 **preferred qualifications**

* production experience with large\-scale data matching and deduplication, or with shared geocoding services
* familiarity with property, building, or location identity concepts (building identifiers, address hierarchies, parcel/structure relationships)
* deep knowledge of spatial analysis and cartographic principles
* experience with databricks or similar lakehouse platforms for large\-scale geospatial data processing
* experience building llm\-powered applications (rag, vector search) or deploying ml models in production
* knowledge of real estate technology and jll’s technology ecosystem
* familiarity with responsible ai practices; professional certifications in cloud, gis, or ai/ml

 **what success looks like**

* delivers high\-quality, scalable applications with integrated gis and ai capabilities
* establishes trusted, consistent property and geospatial data capabilities adopted across enterprise platforms
* increases team velocity through ai tooling and effective mentorship
* ships a geocoding and matching capability that other teams adopt rather than rebuild

remote –chicago, il, dallas, tx, new york, ny, san francisco, ca

title: Machine Learning Engineer

title: Senior Cloud FinOps engineer
description:
ahead builds platforms for digital business. by weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

at ahead, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. we create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at ahead.

we are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

***we embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at ahead.***  


the senior cloud finops engineer leads complex cloud financial management, optimization, and governance activities across multiple managed services clients. this role combines deep public cloud engineering knowledge, financial and operational analysis, customer\-facing advisory capability, and execution discipline to help clients improve visibility, accountability, forecasting accuracy, unit economics, and cost efficiency across aws, azure, and gcp.

  




as a senior member of the practice, this engineer is a recognized subject matter expert who owns higher\-complexity analyses, leads written deliverables and client\-facing advisory discussions, mentors other engineers, and drives improvements to standards, automation, and repeatable delivery practices across the finops service offering. the role operates with a high degree of commercial awareness and mature communication skills, engaging service owners, process owners, finance and procurement stakeholders, and executive audiences directly.

  




the role is performed remotely within the united states and includes up to 10 percent domestic travel, along with occasional after\-hours or weekend support during major incidents, reporting deadlines, approved change windows, or other activities required by contracted service commitments.

  




### **duties / responsibilities**

cloud cost analysis and optimization



* lead detailed analysis of cloud spend, usage trends, allocation accuracy, anomalies, and optimization opportunities across aws, azure, and gcp using native tooling and approved third\-party finops platforms.
* identify, quantify, prioritize, and drive optimization opportunities including rightsizing, idle resource cleanup, storage and data transfer optimization, licensing alignment, and scheduling strategies.
* track optimization opportunities through identified, recommended, approved, implemented, and realized states, validating financial outcomes and avoiding double\-counting or attribution of unrealized savings.
* lead cost visibility and allocation for containerized and kubernetes workloads, including shared cluster cost distribution, namespace and label\-based allocation, and idle capacity analysis.
* analyze and optimize ai and gpu\-related spend, including accelerated compute utilization, model training and inference costs, and consumption of managed ai and machine learning services.
* extend cost analysis to saas, software licensing, and marketplace spend where these fall within the agreed scope of the engagement.



* conduct best\-practices reviews that combine cost analysis with operational excellence analysis, using cloud\-native and approved ahead tooling.
  




allocation, unit economics, and reporting



* lead complex cost allocation and tagging efforts, including governance standards, mapping logic, reporting accuracy, inherited tag strategies, and treatment of non\-taggable resources.
* define and maintain unit economics and cost\-per\-unit metrics that tie cloud spend to business drivers such as customers, transactions, environments, products, or workloads.
* own or lead creation of dashboards, reports, budgets, forecasts, showback and chargeback views, executive summaries, and recurring service review content.
* lead data validation and reconciliation across billing exports, connectors, cost datasets, and reporting models to improve trust in reported values, including work toward standardized billing data formats such as focus.



* implement and maintain continuous tagging governance through cloud\-native policy enforcement and automated remediation scripting, refining coverage as untagged or non\-compliant resources are identified.



* maintain client\-facing finops tooling and portals, ensuring predictive analytics, multi\-account views, and resource, configuration, and environment change reporting remain current and accurate.
  




commitment and rate optimization



* manage commitment portfolios across clients, including reserved capacity and savings plan modeling, purchase recommendations, coverage and utilization targets, expiration and renewal planning, and savings realization tracking.
* support enterprise agreement, private pricing, and committed\-spend discussions by providing consumption analysis, commitment scenarios, and drawdown forecasts to client and ahead stakeholders.
  




client advisory and communication



* develop and present financially grounded recommendations that translate technical findings into business value for engineering, finance, procurement, and executive stakeholders.
* communicate with external customers, including senior management, on matters requiring explanation, interpretation, and advisory judgment, and help client leadership set strategic direction beyond individual tactics.
* translate customer business requirements into technical and financial requirements, and write or lead complex deliverables within the practice.
* partner with cloudops, devops, platform, application, finance, procurement, and client stakeholders to support implementation of recommendations and validate realized outcomes.
* maintain timely ticket updates, work documentation, meeting follow\-ups, and internal and customer communications in accordance with service delivery expectations.



* facilitate recurring client advisory calls that cover cost and billing changes, identify additional systems or workloads the client may want to migrate to the cloud, and gather client feedback on ahead's service delivery performance.
  




engineering, automation, and delivery leadership



* build and maintain queries, data transformations, and automation using sql and at least one scripting language such as python or powershell, in order to reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and increase delivery quality and scale.
* integrate third\-party tools, billing data sources, and reporting platforms into approved finops tooling and governance structures, including onboarding of new clients, accounts, subscriptions, and projects.
* provide credible time and effort estimates based on available information, and prioritize and complete work independently within committed timelines while meeting established quality standards.
* provide technical leadership and coordinate technical delivery resources across skillsets when required, including cross\-practice work and deliverables, without direct personnel\-management responsibility.
* initiate and participate in authoring project change requests when additional work is identified beyond agreed scope.



* execute approved remediation activities, including workload resizing, workload deletion, and commitment implementation, through client ticketing or service\-request workflows, using client\-granted permissions and following client change\-control procedures.



* monitor delivery hours against contracted monthly allocations, flagging utilization trends and coordinating any approved overage or rescoping through the change\-request process.
  




mentorship and practice development



* mentor cloud finops engineers and other team members by reviewing work, sharing methods, improving documentation, and elevating team capability and consistency.
* contribute to internal standards, reusable assets, playbooks, work instructions, and continuous improvement initiatives across the finops practice, and provide measurable input into ahead products, processes, standards, and plans.
* influence direct team members, the broader internal team, and external customers to adopt new concepts, best practices, and approaches.
* serve as a reliable resource for thought leadership content, workshops, industry conferences, and webinars representing the practice.
* support pre\-sales, solutioning, scoping, positioning, and service maturation efforts by providing subject matter expertise, effort input, and delivery perspective, and identify and escalate new client opportunities.



* deliver finops and tooling education and training for client teams to build internal cost\-management capability, in addition to mentoring within the ahead practice.
  




general



* maintain availability during the assigned team's standard business hours, with reasonable flexibility to accommodate recurring client meetings and service reviews across united states time zones.
* participate in the team's on\-call or escalation rotation where applicable to the assigned account portfolio.
* stay current on cloud pricing models, finops best practices, and service capabilities while helping refine how ahead delivers cloud cost optimization and advisory services.
* provide occasional after\-hours support for client meetings, reporting deadlines, change windows, critical incidents, or urgent cost\-related issues when required.
* maintain relevant professional and cloud certifications consistent with role, practice, and individual development requirements, and meet or exceed individual goal objectives.
* other job duties as assigned.
  




### **education and experience**



minimum required –



* bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, finance, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience.
* 5\+ years of combined experience in cloud engineering, cloud operations, infrastructure, or cloud cost management, including at least 3 years focused on cloud financial management, cost optimization, or finops.
* 3\+ years in a customer\-facing, stakeholder\-facing, consulting, or service delivery role with responsibility for presenting findings and recommendations to both technical and business audiences.
* hands\-on experience designing, deploying, or operating large\-scale, multi\-account, multi\-subscription, or enterprise cloud environments.
* subject matter expertise in at least one major public cloud provider (aws, azure, or gcp); strong azure or aws experience preferred, with gcp exposure considered a plus.
* working proficiency in sql and at least one scripting language such as python or powershell, sufficient to query and transform cost datasets and automate recurring reporting.
* experience using cloud cost management, billing analysis, or reporting platforms, whether native cloud tools or approved third\-party solutions.
* demonstrated experience integrating third\-party tools, billing data sources, and reporting platforms.
* strong analytical, spreadsheet, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a shared services or multi\-client environment.
* must be legally authorized to work in the united states.
* ability to successfully complete ahead and client\-required background screening; certain client environments may require additional vetting or clearance.
  




### **preferred experience**

* experience working in a managed services, consulting, or outsourced service delivery environment.
* experience supporting more than one public cloud provider in a finops or cost optimization capacity.
* relevant certifications such as finops certified practitioner, finops certified professional, or aws, azure, and gcp certifications.
* experience with platforms such as harness ccm, apptio cloudability, cloudzero, power bi, tableau, sql, python, or powershell.
* experience with forecasting, budgeting, allocation methodologies, showback or chargeback models, commitment planning, and savings realization tracking.
* familiarity with the finops framework and with standardized billing data formats such as focus.
* experience with kubernetes or container cost allocation, and with ai or gpu cost management.
* experience leading or mentoring junior engineers and reviewing deliverables for quality and consistency.
* familiarity with ticketing and workflow platforms such as servicenow, jira, or similar tools.
* experience contributing to pre\-sales activities, including scoping, positioning, and technology adoption.

### **knowledge , skills , abilities**

* advanced understanding of cloud billing constructs including on\-demand usage, reserved capacity, savings plans or commitments, amortization, allocation methods, and forecasting drivers.
* working knowledge of unit economics concepts and the ability to connect infrastructure consumption to business and product metrics.
* understanding of performance, scaling, and functional characteristics of cloud and open\-source technologies, with the ability to recommend standard design patterns and best practices.
* understanding of cost behavior in containerized, serverless, data platform, and accelerated computing environments.
* strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets, identify trends, quantify financial impact, and convert findings into prioritized recommendations.
* ability to communicate technical and financial concepts clearly to technical, operational, procurement, finance, and executive audiences.
* strong written, verbal, and presentation skills with a professional customer\-facing presence and the ability to lead recurring advisory discussions.
* ability to lead work independently in higher\-complexity situations while also collaborating effectively across distributed teams, time zones, and functions.
* strong documentation, organization, and time management skills with consistent follow\-through and attention to detail.
* demonstrated ownership mindset with the ability to balance competing priorities in a fast\-paced multi\-client environment while maintaining service quality.
* continuous improvement mindset with an interest in automation, standardization, methodology refinement, and scalable service delivery.
* ability to mentor others, improve team capability, and contribute positively to practice development and knowledge sharing.
* strong project and situational awareness, with the judgment to escalate appropriately and accept responsibility for individual and team outcomes.
  




### **culture and responsibilities**

* support initiatives beyond immediate area of responsibility and encourage cross\-team interaction.
* motivate people to think creatively and achieve success through others.
* consistently pursue self\-development and advance the ahead delivery model for self and teammates.
* bring a positive, team\-oriented attitude toward ahead, its clients, and its partners, including willingness to extend effort beyond normal working hours for short intervals to support a client initiative or production rollout.

title: Senior Data/AI Architect
description:

 ***why join cng?***

**employee ownership:** every employee receives equity shares, enabling you to participate in our company's growth and prosperity.

**work\-life balance:** we support true work\-life integration for all cng employee owners.

**career growth:** advance your career within our expanding network of manufacturing facilities with comprehensive training and development programs.

**purpose\-driven work:** help create sustainable packaging solutions that reduce food waste and protect our environment for future generations.

from supporting internal teams to developing next\-gen materials, our professional roles span strategy, innovation, and purpose. at cng, you’ll do work that matters—and own it all.

* design scalable architectures for enterprise data, analytics, machine learning, and ai solutions.
* remain hands\-on in the development of python, sql, data pipelines, apis, and production applications.
* design and build integrations across erp, manufacturing, operational, commercial, finance, and other enterprise systems.

* define reusable patterns for integrating models and ai capabilities into business applications and workflows.
* partner directly with manufacturing and business teams to understand operational processes and translate them into technical solutions.

* evaluate technologies and architecture decisions based on scalability, maintainability, cost, and business value.
* mentor data engineers, analytics engineers, data scientists, and analysts and raise engineering standards across the team.
* support modernization and simplification of legacy data and analytics systems.
* periodically travel to cng manufacturing locations to support high\-value operational and manufacturing initiatives.
**what you’ll bring**

**essential qualifications:**

* 8\+ years of experience across data architecture, data engineering, machine learning engineering, software engineering, data science, or related technical disciplines.
* strong hands\-on python and sql experience.
* demonstrated experience designing and delivering production data and/or ml systems.
* experience with modern cloud data platforms and enterprise data architecture.
* experience designing apis, services, or integrations between analytical platforms and business applications.
* understanding of modern software engineering practices including git, ci/cd, automated testing, monitoring, and deployment.
* experience leading complex technical initiatives and mentoring technical professionals.
* ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and senior business stakeholders.

**compensation \& benefits**

**total rewards:**

* **employee ownership** – become a company owner day 1!
* full medical, dental, and vision insurance upon hire
* holiday pay
* paid vacation
* 401(k) with company match
* performance\-based bonuses
* tuition reimbursement
* career advancement opportunities across 18\+ facilities

join a team where every voice matters, every contribution counts, and every employee shares in our success.

title: Senior Cloud FinOps engineer
description:
ahead builds platforms for digital business. by weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

at ahead, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. we create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at ahead.

we are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

***we embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at ahead.***  


the senior cloud finops engineer leads complex cloud financial management, optimization, and governance activities across multiple managed services clients. this role combines deep public cloud engineering knowledge, financial and operational analysis, customer\-facing advisory capability, and execution discipline to help clients improve visibility, accountability, forecasting accuracy, unit economics, and cost efficiency across aws, azure, and gcp.

  




as a senior member of the practice, this engineer is a recognized subject matter expert who owns higher\-complexity analyses, leads written deliverables and client\-facing advisory discussions, mentors other engineers, and drives improvements to standards, automation, and repeatable delivery practices across the finops service offering. the role operates with a high degree of commercial awareness and mature communication skills, engaging service owners, process owners, finance and procurement stakeholders, and executive audiences directly.

  




the role is performed remotely within the united states and includes up to 10 percent domestic travel, along with occasional after\-hours or weekend support during major incidents, reporting deadlines, approved change windows, or other activities required by contracted service commitments.

  




### **duties / responsibilities**

cloud cost analysis and optimization



* lead detailed analysis of cloud spend, usage trends, allocation accuracy, anomalies, and optimization opportunities across aws, azure, and gcp using native tooling and approved third\-party finops platforms.
* identify, quantify, prioritize, and drive optimization opportunities including rightsizing, idle resource cleanup, storage and data transfer optimization, licensing alignment, and scheduling strategies.
* track optimization opportunities through identified, recommended, approved, implemented, and realized states, validating financial outcomes and avoiding double\-counting or attribution of unrealized savings.
* lead cost visibility and allocation for containerized and kubernetes workloads, including shared cluster cost distribution, namespace and label\-based allocation, and idle capacity analysis.
* analyze and optimize ai and gpu\-related spend, including accelerated compute utilization, model training and inference costs, and consumption of managed ai and machine learning services.
* extend cost analysis to saas, software licensing, and marketplace spend where these fall within the agreed scope of the engagement.



* conduct best\-practices reviews that combine cost analysis with operational excellence analysis, using cloud\-native and approved ahead tooling.
  




allocation, unit economics, and reporting



* lead complex cost allocation and tagging efforts, including governance standards, mapping logic, reporting accuracy, inherited tag strategies, and treatment of non\-taggable resources.
* define and maintain unit economics and cost\-per\-unit metrics that tie cloud spend to business drivers such as customers, transactions, environments, products, or workloads.
* own or lead creation of dashboards, reports, budgets, forecasts, showback and chargeback views, executive summaries, and recurring service review content.
* lead data validation and reconciliation across billing exports, connectors, cost datasets, and reporting models to improve trust in reported values, including work toward standardized billing data formats such as focus.



* implement and maintain continuous tagging governance through cloud\-native policy enforcement and automated remediation scripting, refining coverage as untagged or non\-compliant resources are identified.



* maintain client\-facing finops tooling and portals, ensuring predictive analytics, multi\-account views, and resource, configuration, and environment change reporting remain current and accurate.
  




commitment and rate optimization



* manage commitment portfolios across clients, including reserved capacity and savings plan modeling, purchase recommendations, coverage and utilization targets, expiration and renewal planning, and savings realization tracking.
* support enterprise agreement, private pricing, and committed\-spend discussions by providing consumption analysis, commitment scenarios, and drawdown forecasts to client and ahead stakeholders.
  




client advisory and communication



* develop and present financially grounded recommendations that translate technical findings into business value for engineering, finance, procurement, and executive stakeholders.
* communicate with external customers, including senior management, on matters requiring explanation, interpretation, and advisory judgment, and help client leadership set strategic direction beyond individual tactics.
* translate customer business requirements into technical and financial requirements, and write or lead complex deliverables within the practice.
* partner with cloudops, devops, platform, application, finance, procurement, and client stakeholders to support implementation of recommendations and validate realized outcomes.
* maintain timely ticket updates, work documentation, meeting follow\-ups, and internal and customer communications in accordance with service delivery expectations.



* facilitate recurring client advisory calls that cover cost and billing changes, identify additional systems or workloads the client may want to migrate to the cloud, and gather client feedback on ahead's service delivery performance.
  




engineering, automation, and delivery leadership



* build and maintain queries, data transformations, and automation using sql and at least one scripting language such as python or powershell, in order to reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and increase delivery quality and scale.
* integrate third\-party tools, billing data sources, and reporting platforms into approved finops tooling and governance structures, including onboarding of new clients, accounts, subscriptions, and projects.
* provide credible time and effort estimates based on available information, and prioritize and complete work independently within committed timelines while meeting established quality standards.
* provide technical leadership and coordinate technical delivery resources across skillsets when required, including cross\-practice work and deliverables, without direct personnel\-management responsibility.
* initiate and participate in authoring project change requests when additional work is identified beyond agreed scope.



* execute approved remediation activities, including workload resizing, workload deletion, and commitment implementation, through client ticketing or service\-request workflows, using client\-granted permissions and following client change\-control procedures.



* monitor delivery hours against contracted monthly allocations, flagging utilization trends and coordinating any approved overage or rescoping through the change\-request process.
  




mentorship and practice development



* mentor cloud finops engineers and other team members by reviewing work, sharing methods, improving documentation, and elevating team capability and consistency.
* contribute to internal standards, reusable assets, playbooks, work instructions, and continuous improvement initiatives across the finops practice, and provide measurable input into ahead products, processes, standards, and plans.
* influence direct team members, the broader internal team, and external customers to adopt new concepts, best practices, and approaches.
* serve as a reliable resource for thought leadership content, workshops, industry conferences, and webinars representing the practice.
* support pre\-sales, solutioning, scoping, positioning, and service maturation efforts by providing subject matter expertise, effort input, and delivery perspective, and identify and escalate new client opportunities.



* deliver finops and tooling education and training for client teams to build internal cost\-management capability, in addition to mentoring within the ahead practice.
  




general



* maintain availability during the assigned team's standard business hours, with reasonable flexibility to accommodate recurring client meetings and service reviews across united states time zones.
* participate in the team's on\-call or escalation rotation where applicable to the assigned account portfolio.
* stay current on cloud pricing models, finops best practices, and service capabilities while helping refine how ahead delivers cloud cost optimization and advisory services.
* provide occasional after\-hours support for client meetings, reporting deadlines, change windows, critical incidents, or urgent cost\-related issues when required.
* maintain relevant professional and cloud certifications consistent with role, practice, and individual development requirements, and meet or exceed individual goal objectives.
* other job duties as assigned.
  




### **education and experience**



minimum required –



* bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, finance, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience.
* 5\+ years of combined experience in cloud engineering, cloud operations, infrastructure, or cloud cost management, including at least 3 years focused on cloud financial management, cost optimization, or finops.
* 3\+ years in a customer\-facing, stakeholder\-facing, consulting, or service delivery role with responsibility for presenting findings and recommendations to both technical and business audiences.
* hands\-on experience designing, deploying, or operating large\-scale, multi\-account, multi\-subscription, or enterprise cloud environments.
* subject matter expertise in at least one major public cloud provider (aws, azure, or gcp); strong azure or aws experience preferred, with gcp exposure considered a plus.
* working proficiency in sql and at least one scripting language such as python or powershell, sufficient to query and transform cost datasets and automate recurring reporting.
* experience using cloud cost management, billing analysis, or reporting platforms, whether native cloud tools or approved third\-party solutions.
* demonstrated experience integrating third\-party tools, billing data sources, and reporting platforms.
* strong analytical, spreadsheet, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a shared services or multi\-client environment.
* must be legally authorized to work in the united states.
* ability to successfully complete ahead and client\-required background screening; certain client environments may require additional vetting or clearance.
  




### **preferred experience**

* experience working in a managed services, consulting, or outsourced service delivery environment.
* experience supporting more than one public cloud provider in a finops or cost optimization capacity.
* relevant certifications such as finops certified practitioner, finops certified professional, or aws, azure, and gcp certifications.
* experience with platforms such as harness ccm, apptio cloudability, cloudzero, power bi, tableau, sql, python, or powershell.
* experience with forecasting, budgeting, allocation methodologies, showback or chargeback models, commitment planning, and savings realization tracking.
* familiarity with the finops framework and with standardized billing data formats such as focus.
* experience with kubernetes or container cost allocation, and with ai or gpu cost management.
* experience leading or mentoring junior engineers and reviewing deliverables for quality and consistency.
* familiarity with ticketing and workflow platforms such as servicenow, jira, or similar tools.
* experience contributing to pre\-sales activities, including scoping, positioning, and technology adoption.

### **knowledge , skills , abilities**

* advanced understanding of cloud billing constructs including on\-demand usage, reserved capacity, savings plans or commitments, amortization, allocation methods, and forecasting drivers.
* working knowledge of unit economics concepts and the ability to connect infrastructure consumption to business and product metrics.
* understanding of performance, scaling, and functional characteristics of cloud and open\-source technologies, with the ability to recommend standard design patterns and best practices.
* understanding of cost behavior in containerized, serverless, data platform, and accelerated computing environments.
* strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets, identify trends, quantify financial impact, and convert findings into prioritized recommendations.
* ability to communicate technical and financial concepts clearly to technical, operational, procurement, finance, and executive audiences.
* strong written, verbal, and presentation skills with a professional customer\-facing presence and the ability to lead recurring advisory discussions.
* ability to lead work independently in higher\-complexity situations while also collaborating effectively across distributed teams, time zones, and functions.
* strong documentation, organization, and time management skills with consistent follow\-through and attention to detail.
* demonstrated ownership mindset with the ability to balance competing priorities in a fast\-paced multi\-client environment while maintaining service quality.
* continuous improvement mindset with an interest in automation, standardization, methodology refinement, and scalable service delivery.
* ability to mentor others, improve team capability, and contribute positively to practice development and knowledge sharing.
* strong project and situational awareness, with the judgment to escalate appropriately and accept responsibility for individual and team outcomes.
  




### **culture and responsibilities**

* support initiatives beyond immediate area of responsibility and encourage cross\-team interaction.
* motivate people to think creatively and achieve success through others.
* consistently pursue self\-development and advance the ahead delivery model for self and teammates.
* bring a positive, team\-oriented attitude toward ahead, its clients, and its partners, including willingness to extend effort beyond normal working hours for short intervals to support a client initiative or production rollout.

republic services, inc. (nyse: rsg) is a leader in the environmental services industry. we provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. our industry\-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.

  

in 2025, republic’s total company revenue was $16\.6 billion, and adjusted ebitda was $5\.3 billion. we serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.

  

although we operate across north america, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. by combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day\-to\-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.

  

our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. they choose republic services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.

* **safe**: we protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
* **committed to serve**: we go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
* **environmentally responsible:** we take action to improve our environment.
* **driven**: we deliver results in the right way.
* **human\-centered:** we respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

  

we are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86\. we have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. in addition, our team positively impacted 5\.1 million people in 2024 through the republic services charitable foundation and local community grants. these projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.  



  

**strategy**


republic services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a north american footprint of vertically integrated assets.


we focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.


with our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. for example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. and as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.

 **recycling and waste**


we continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout north america through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. the 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick\-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. we aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. in addition, we are cross\-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.

 **environmental solutions**


our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. we are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. we see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including pfas remediation, an increasing customer need.

 **sustainability innovation**


republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.

  

the republic services polymer center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. these innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle\-to\-bottle circularity. we also formed blue polymers, a joint venture with ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our polymer centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. we are building a network of polymer centers and blue polymer facilities across north america.

  

our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct renewable natural gas (rng) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

title: DIR OF SW SYSTEMS ENGINEERING -10378
description:
over 50,000 customers globally trust our end\-to\-end, cloud\-driven networking solutions. they rely on our top\-rated services and support to accelerate their digital transformation efforts and deliver unprecedented progress. with double\-digit growth year over year, no provider is better positioned to deliver scalable outcomes than extreme.  

inclusion is one of our core values and in our dna. we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that embraces our differences and creates an atmosphere where all our employees thrive because of their differences, not in spite of them.  

become part of something big with extreme! as a global networking leader, learn why there’s no better time to join the extreme team. **title of position: director of sw engineering \-exchange**


**position type:** full time


**location:** san jose/seattle, wa / san jose, ca


**position reports to: sr director of sw engineering**


**application deadline:** applications are being accepted on a rolling basis and this posting will remain open until filled.


**work authorization:** applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where the role will be performed.

  



are you energized by the idea of shaping the future of generative ai and agentic systems? do you want to help define how intelligent agents discover capabilities, use tools, collaborate across systems, and deliver meaningful outcomes for customers? do you aspire to create global impact while tackling challenges at the intersection of ai, distributed systems, cloud platforms, security, and large\-scale product engineering?

  



then come, advance with us.

  



this is an incredible opportunity to work at the forefront of ai\-driven networking, agentic automation, cloud\-native platforms, and intelligent product experiences. you will help lead the development of a next\-generation platform that enables an ecosystem of ai agents, tools, skills, and integrations designed to support highly scalable, secure, reliable, and adaptable enterprise use cases.

  



there has never been a better time to join extreme. following several acquisitions that have expanded our portfolio and go\-to\-market strategy, we continue to see significant opportunity and growth across regions. as a technology leader in the gartner magic quadrant, extreme is also deeply committed to fostering a culture that embraces diversity, inclusion, and equality in the workplace. our motto is “advance with us,” and it applies to everyone we work with — inside and outside the company.

  



we are driving a fundamental shift in how businesses manage wired and wireless networks by building high\-performance, real\-time systems that can perceive, reason, retrieve context, use tools, and take intelligent action on behalf of users. you will lead engineering teams working on strategic ai platform capabilities, including agent orchestration, tool and skill ecosystems, secure integration frameworks, scalable microservices, and enterprise\-grade runtime infrastructure. you will partner closely with product, architecture, security, cloud operations, and other engineering leaders to define the technical direction and deliver high\-impact systems that are reliable, extensible, and built for long\-term scale.

  


**job responsibilities**

  


* provide visionary technical and organisational leadership for teams building next\-generation ai agent platforms, tool ecosystems, and cloud\-native services, including agent orchestration, tool invocation, skill discovery, workflow execution, context management, and governance.


* define and drive the engineering roadmap for highly scalable, secure, reliable, and extensible systems that enable ai agents, tools, skills, integrations, and enterprise workflows across extreme’s product portfolio.


* build, mentor, and lead high\-performing teams, including hiring, performance management, developing leaders, and fostering a culture of strong engineering standards, accountability, and innovation.


* drive execution across multiple programs and teams, ensuring clear priorities, predictable delivery, effective risk management, and alignment with product, architecture, security, cloudops, and senior leadership.


* guide complex architectural and technical decisions, including trade\-offs related to distributed systems, multi\-agent workflows, latency, reliability, cost efficiency, tenant isolation, data privacy, and platform extensibility.


* champion production readiness and operational excellence, including secure\-by\-design development, api consistency, observability, slos, capacity planning, resiliency, automation, and measurable quality outcomes.


* stay current with emerging ai and platform trends, including agent frameworks, mcpbased tooling, skill ecosystems, rag patterns, llm integration, evaluation, guardrails, and enterprise ai governance.

  


**basic qualifications**

  


* bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, machine learning, mathematics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.


* 15\+ years of software engineering experience, including 10\+ years of engineering leadership experience and 5\+ years managing managers or multiple engineering teams.


* proven track record of designing, delivering, and operating complex, high\-impact ai, ml, generative ai, automation, or intelligent software platforms.


* strong practical understanding of generative ai and agentic architectures, including llm integration, model context protocol, rag, agents, tools, skills, orchestration, context/memory, evaluation, guardrails, observability, and policy controls.


* experience leading teams that build scalable, secure, and reliable cloud\-native ai or dataintensive services, with strong depth in distributed systems, microservices, apis, and production operations.


* experience managing multiple concurrent programs and engineering teams in an agile or iterative product development environment.


* strong communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with executives, product leaders, architects, senior engineers, security teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders.

  



preferred qualifications

  


* ms or phd in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, distributed systems, or equivalent experience.


* experience with agentic ai platforms, ai agent frameworks, tool\-use systems, mcp\-style integrations, plugin ecosystems, workflow automation, developer platforms, or skill marketplaces.


* experience building or leading extensible platforms where multiple teams, services, or partners contribute capabilities through apis, sdks, plugins, tools, integrations, or developer\-facing interfaces.


* experience designing secure, governed platforms that support permissions, tenant isolation, auditability, rate limiting, policy controls, observability, and safe tool execution.


* experience with cloud platforms and modern infrastructure technologies such as aws, azure, gcp, kubernetes, docker, kafka, sql/nosql databases, search systems, vector databases, graph databases, or event streaming platforms.


* experience partnering with product management and program management to define strategy, clarify requirements, manage trade\-offs, and deliver customer\-facing platform capabilities.

  



come work with a team of highly talented engineers and scientists and help define the next



generation of ai\-driven networking experiences. advance with us to achieve new heights every



day.

  



### **equal employment opportunity**


* extreme networks, inc. is an equal opportunity employer. qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. we are committed to taking affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans, including disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active\-duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and armed forces service medal veterans.


* extreme networks also strives to prevent other, subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (for example, stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our organization. whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at extreme networks. we encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.


### **fair chance and background checks**


* extreme networks will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the california fair chance act, los angeles fair chance initiative for hiring ordinance, los angeles county fair chance ordinance for employers, philadelphia fair criminal record screening standards ordinance, illinois human rights act, cook county human rights ordinance, seattle fair chance employment ordinance, and the san francisco fair chance ordinance. an applicant's conviction history will not be considered until after a conditional offer of employment has been made. following any individualized assessment, applicants will be provided with the opportunity to respond before any adverse action is taken.
* extreme networks does not seek salary history information from applicants and will not rely on salary history in determining whether to offer employment or in setting compensation.

#### **benefits and total rewards:**

title: Senior AI Engineer - Observability
description:
sr ai engineer (observability)



function: engineering



reports to: director, software engineering



location: remote \- united states


**position summary**



onboard is a board intelligence platform trusted by over 6,000 organizations to simplify governance, and we are building ai\-powered product experiences across rag pipelines, semantic search, summarization, and emerging agentic workflows. we are looking for a senior ai engineer to help make those experiences reliable, measurable, cost\-effective, and safe in production.



this is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who wants to build ai systems, not just observe them. you will partner with product engineering teams to design and improve ai features, instrument them deeply, and — critically — define how we know those features actually work. you will build the evaluation pipelines and datasets that tell us whether an ai experience is good enough to ship, analyze real\-world behavior, and turn production signals into product and architecture improvements.



you will help define how onboard ships ai: how we test prompts and retrieval quality, detect regressions, monitor cost and latency, evaluate user\-facing quality, and safely evolve models, prompts, datasets, and providers over time.



the right person is a strong software engineer with practical llm application experience and a genuine quality mindset. you care not only that an ai feature works in a demo, but that it performs consistently for customers, degrades gracefully, provides traceable results, and improves through feedback loops. and you have real opinions about what makes an evaluation trustworthy — not just that one exists, but whether it measures the right thing.


**what you'll do**


**build and improve ai\-powered product systems**


* partner with product engineers to design, build, and improve ai features using llms, rag, semantic search, and agentic workflows


* contribute directly to production codebases in python, c\#/.net, or related technologies


* improve prompt, retrieval, context assembly, ranking, grounding, and response\-generation patterns


* help teams make practical architecture tradeoffs across quality, latency, cost, privacy, and maintainability


* support model and provider evaluations, migrations, fallback strategies, and rollout plans


**make ai quality measurable — define what "good enough" means**



this is a defining pillar of the role, not an afterthought. it is not enough to have an evaluation; you will be responsible for whether our evaluations are adequate.


* design and implement evaluation pipelines for llm\-powered features, and build scoring methodologies from first principles rather than reaching for the nearest metric


* build and maintain versioned golden datasets covering real\-world use cases, edge cases, failure modes, and customer\-critical workflows


* implement llm\-as\-judge, heuristic, human\-feedback, and task\-specific quality scoring approaches


* establish the criteria that determine whether an existing evaluation is sufficient for a given feature and risk profile — and identify gaps before they become production issues


* establish prompt and retrieval regression testing as part of the development lifecycle


* define quality gates and thresholds that help teams know when an ai feature is ready to ship


**own observability, reliability, and cost signals**


* instrument llm interactions, rag pipelines, tool calls, and agent workflows using observability platforms (onboard currently uses arize; comparable tools include langfuse, langsmith, w\&b, and opentelemetry\-based stacks)


* track latency, token usage, cost, retrieval quality, groundedness, failure modes, safety signals, and user feedback


* build dashboards and alerts that surface meaningful product and engineering signals, not just raw telemetry


* analyze production traces to identify quality issues, cost spikes, regressions, and improvement opportunities


* create runbooks and response patterns for common llm and ai\-product failure modes


**scale ai quality across teams**


* build reusable libraries, sdks, templates, and reference implementations that make correct ai instrumentation and evaluation easy


* document standards for tracing, metadata, prompt/version tracking, evaluation, cost reporting, and incident response


* coach product teams on ai quality, evaluation design, observability, and reliable release practices


* help establish shared patterns that let onboard scale ai development across product lines


**support responsible and compliant ai delivery**


* ensure ai systems handle sensitive data appropriately and align with security, privacy, soc 2, iso 27001, and data\-residency requirements


* monitor guardrails, policy enforcement, content safety signals, and safety\-related anomalies as a distinct observability concern


* support auditability and traceability of ai interactions where required

  


**what we're looking for**


**required**


* 5\+ years of software engineering experience building production systems


* hands\-on experience building or operating llm\-powered features, rag systems, ai workflows, or similar ai applications


* strong engineering ability in python, c\#/.net, or both


* practical understanding of prompts, embeddings, vector search, retrieval quality, orchestration patterns, and llm application architecture


* experience designing evaluations, quality metrics, or regression frameworks for ai or software systems — with the judgment to assess whether an evaluation actually measures what matters


* strong observability fundamentals: tracing, logging, metrics, alerting, and production debugging


* experience with ci/cd, git workflows, cloud environments, and production release practices (azure devops preferred)


* ability to communicate clearly with engineering, product, qa, security, and business stakeholders


* strong product judgment and genuine curiosity about how ai systems behave with real users


* proficiency with ai\-assisted development tools (e.g., claude code, playerzero)


**preferred**


* experience with llmops or ai observability tools such as arize, langfuse, langsmith, w\&b, humanloop, or helicone


* experience with opentelemetry, azure monitor, application insights, or similar observability platforms


* experience with azure ai search, pinecone, qdrant, weaviate, pgvector, or other vector search platforms


* experience with semantic kernel, langchain, llamaindex, autogen, or related frameworks


* experience with llm\-as\-judge evaluation, rag evaluation, semantic similarity metrics, hallucination detection, groundedness scoring, or human\-feedback workflows


* experience with dedicated evaluation frameworks (e.g., deepeval, langtest) and benchmarking approaches for llm outputs


* experience with a/b testing, online experimentation, or product analytics for ai features


* experience in regulated environments with soc 2, iso 27001, pii handling, or data\-residency requirements


* background in qa, ml, or data engineering that informs a rigorous approach to quality measurement

  


**you'll be successful if you**


* make ai feature quality measurable and visible


* help teams detect regressions before customers do


* improve reliability, latency, cost, and user trust in ai\-powered experiences


* build reusable patterns that reduce friction for every product team


* translate ambiguous ai behavior into concrete engineering actions


* balance innovation with operational discipline

  


**why this role matters**



ai is becoming a core part of the onboard product experience. this role helps determine whether that ai is merely impressive in demos or dependable for thousands of organizations making important governance decisions.



you will have the opportunity to shape onboard's ai engineering standards, influence product architecture, and build the systems that let teams ship ai faster, safer, and with greater confidence.

  


**competencies**


* accountability


* adaptability


* ai curiosity / innovation


* applied learning


* business acumen


* collaboration


* customer focus


* dealing with ambiguity


* decision making


* driving for results

**about the company:**



boards set the standard for what organizations can achieve. at onboard, our board management software helps boards function at a higher level so every organization can make a bigger difference in the world.



launched in 2011, today, onboard serves as the board intelligence platform for more than 5,000 organizations and their 12,000 boards and committees in 60 countries worldwide. with customers in higher education, nonprofit, healthcare systems, government, and enterprise business, onboard is the leading board management provider.



onboard has grown from a class project at purdue university in west lafayette, indiana in 2003 into the world's leading board management software platform today. backed by jmi equity and the acquisitions of escribe and govenda, onboard is positioned to become the industry leader in board management and meeting solutions for private and public sector entities.

required**:**

* experience deploying and supporting ml pipelines and production models, including monitoring, troubleshooting, versioning, rollback, and release management
